title: Property Dealer Shot in Muzaffarpur, Bihar
summary: A property dealer was shot dead by two shooters in Muzaffarpur, Bihar. The incident occurred on January 10th at a real estate office. Police claimed the shooters were from Sita Ram Sena, a local gang. The government alleged that the motive behind the killing was to instill fear among rival gangs. The opposition demanded an investigation into the incident and called for the arrest of those responsible.
summary_points: A property dealer was shot dead in Muzaffarpur, Bihar on January 10th.
Two shooters were involved in the incident, identified as members of Sita Ram Sena.

title_hi: मुजफ्फरपुर में प्रॉपर्टी डीलर को गोली मारकर हत्या
summary_hi: मुजफ्फरपुर में एक प्रॉपर्टी डीलर को दो शूटरों ने गोली मारकर हत्या कर दिया। घटना 10 जनवरी को एक रियल एस्टेट ऑफिस में हुई। पुलिस ने बताया कि शूटर सीता राम सेना के सदस्य थे। सरकार ने आरोप लगाया कि हत्या में डर दिखाने की इच्छा थी। विपक्ष ने घटना पर जांच करने और जिम्मेदारों को गिरफ्तार करने का आह्वान किया।
